name: trivago MCP
description: Searches live hotel prices across booking sites by destination or landmark and forecasts monthly price trends via trivago's free, no-auth remote MCP server, for travelers and trip planners.

skills.name: Accommodation Search
skills.description: Searches live hotel and accommodation listings by destination, with prices, ratings, amenities and filters for stars and guest rating.

skills.name: Radius Search
skills.description: Searches live hotel listings near specific coordinates such as a landmark, venue or neighborhood, with the same filters.

skills.name: Destination Price Trends
skills.description: Forecasts average, minimum and maximum nightly hotel rates by month and star rating for a destination across a date window.
